Justin, saw Akkio land the Havas partnership off their 400M-euro agentic-AI bet, plus the LiveRamp tie-up.

Momentum like that usually opens more accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Akkio off your partnership and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Justin, quick follow-up for Akkio.

With marquee partnerships landing, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most sales leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Akkio needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Justin, last bit of proof for Akkio.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Akkio's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
